title: Beru Lars
description: Beru Lars was married to Owen Lars. They made their living as moisture farmers on Tatooine. The couple raised Luke Skywalker after Obi-Wan Kenobi brought them the infant to hide him from his father. She was a calm presence as opposed to Owen's brusque manner. Beru and Owen fought hard against Reva, the Third Sister, when she came for Luke.
